reason: User requested progressing through power, differential USB, and SPI signal routing (Milestone 12).
impact: Motherboard design is now ~90% complete. Core routing is established, laying down low-impedance power networks and matched high-speed signal channels.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - PCB Layout Floorplan & Outline Initialized

Configured coordinate placements for all major modules: ESP32-S3 module at the top, J5 screen connector in the center, 5 tactile keys in a D-pad arrangement below, USB-C connector on the bottom edge, power charging/regulation in the bottom-right quadrant, and isolated analog quadrants for the optical TIA sensor (left-middle) and the AD5933 EC sensor (right-middle).
reason: User requested moving to PCB Layout phase including outline, floorplanning, and component placement coordinates.
impact: Motherboard design has transitioned to the physical layout phase (Milestone 11 complete). Ensures complete separation between sensitive analog sensor sections and high-speed digital/power circuitry.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - Sheet 10 (Manufacturing & Mechanical) Schematic Generated

Consolidated assembly guidelines, including solder mask color selection, 1.6mm board thickness, and component spacing requirements. Consolidated all ten subsheets into the master KiCad schematic tree. Generated final netlist riohs_b4_pcb.net and BOM csv.
reason: User requested mechanical mounting, fiducials, assembly notes, and final sheet integration on Sheet 10.
impact: Motherboard schematic design is now 100% complete across all 10 sheets. Ready for physical routing, ERC/DRC verification in KiCad GUI, and Gerber packaging.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - Sheet 9 (Sensors & External Connectors) Schematic Generated
description: Generated Sheet 9 (Sensors & External Connectors) schematic inside the KiCad project. Consolidated expansion and debug pin headers including J7 (I2C Expansion 1x04 header, LCSC: C124375), J8 (UART Debug 1x05 header, LCSC: C124376), and J9 (SPI display breakout 1x06 header, LCSC: C124377). Wired SRV05-4 ESD TVS arrays (LCSC: C85273) on SPI, I2C, and UART debug channels to provide transient protection for exposed pins. Connected 100-ohm series resistors (C22775) on I2C (SDA/SCL) and UART debug lines (TX/RX) to limit currents during external faults. Updated the master netlist and BOM CSV.
reason: User requested organizing all debug headers, SPI breaks, and external connectors on Sheet 9 with TVS/ESD protection.
impact: Motherboard is now ~90% complete. Protects the core ESP32-S3 pins from transient spikes and external user handling errors, ensuring robust production field deployments.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - Sheet 8 (Piezo/Buzzer Driver) Schematic Generated
description: Generated Sheet 8 (Buzzer Driver) schematic inside the KiCad project. Optimized the design to use a low-side N-channel MOSFET switch (2N7002, LCSC: C20917) instead of a complex gate driver. Added a parallel flyback Schottky diode (BAT54, LCSC: C8164) across the buzzer pins to clamp inductive voltage spikes from magnetic buzzer coils. Configured a 100-ohm gate resistor (C22775) and a 100k-ohm gate pull-down resistor (C25803). Routed the control pin to ESP32-S3 GPIO26 for PWM tone generation. Added a JST PH 2-pin connector (C157929) for the buzzer probe interface. Updated the netlist and BOM files.
reason: User suggested simplified low-side MOSFET switching for audio feedback instead of a heavy gate driver, along with system-level verification.
impact: Motherboard is now ~85% complete. Cleanly integrates a protected, low-side switched buzzer driver using minimal component overhead.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - Sheet 7 (Display & UI) Schematic Generated
description: Generated Sheet 7 (Display & UI) schematic inside the KiCad project. Added standard 1x08 pin header (C124379) to interface with modular 1.8-inch ST7735S TFT SPI screens. Configured high-efficiency 2N7002 N-channel MOSFET backlight switch (C20917) driven by ESP32-S3 GPIO21 (TFT_BL_PWM), with a 39-ohm current-limiting resistor. Routed SPI lines to ESP32-S3 pins (CS -> GPIO9, SCK -> GPIO10, MOSI -> GPIO11, DC -> GPIO13, RST -> GPIO14). Added five debounced TS-1187A tactile keys (C318597) for navigation (UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT/OK) with external 10k pull-ups and 100nF hardware debounce capacitors. Generated the updated netlist riohs_b4_pcb.net and BOM csv.
reason: User requested progressing towards the user interface and navigation controls on the motherboard.
impact: Motherboard is now ~80% complete, fully integrating the 1.8-inch TFT display output and five debounced active-low tactile keys for navigation.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - Sheet 6 (Temperature Sensor) Schematic Generated
description: Generated Sheet 6 (Temperature Sensor) schematic inside the KiCad project. Configured a voltage divider using a 10k-ohm pull-up resistor (C25804) to +3.3V and a 100nF filter capacitor (C14663) in parallel to ground for noise suppression. Routed the temperature sense node directly to ESP32-S3 GPIO7 (ADC1_CH6). Updated the MCLK pin in Sheet 5 to float, in compliance with the AD5933 internal clock datasheet guidelines. Generated the updated netlist riohs_b4_pcb.net and BOM riohs_b4_bom.csv.
reason: User requested progressing towards temperature monitoring and correct AD5933 master clock routing.
impact: Motherboard is now ~70% complete, integrating the precision NTC thermistor read circuit alongside the previous blocks, ensuring correct master clock operation.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - Sheet 5 (EC Measurement) Schematic Generated
description: Generated Sheet 5 (EC Measurement) schematic inside the KiCad project. Integrated Analog Devices AD5933WYDKZ 12-bit impedance analyzer (C16790) using its internal reference clock. Added TLV9062IDR dual precision op-amp (C109503) for unity-gain excitation buffering and return current transimpedance reception. Included a 10uF DC-blocking capacitor (C19702) to prevent milk electrolysis, a 1k-ohm current-limiting safety resistor, on-board 10k-ohm 0.1% calibration resistor (C25804), and 4.7k-ohm I2C pull-ups. Generated the updated monolithic netlist riohs_b4_pcb.net and CSV BOM riohs_b4_bom.csv representing Sheets 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.
reason: User requested progressing towards the electrochemical sensor interfaces on the monolithic motherboard.
impact: Motherboard is now ~65% complete, integrating the high-precision AC impedance spectrometry frontend (AD5933) with safe DC-free probe connections.

title: RIOHS B4 Milk Tester Motherboard - Sheet 4 (Optical Front End) Schematic Generated

Integrated two Everlight PD204-6C silicon PIN photodiodes (C20600) for reference (PD_REF) and measurement (PD_MAIN). Integrated TLV9062IDR dual precision op-amp (C109503) configured in photovoltaic mode with 100k feedback resistors and 22pF filter caps. Generated the updated monolithic netlist riohs_b4_pcb.net and CSV BOM riohs_b4_bom.csv representing Sheets 1, 2, 3, and 4.
reason: User requested progressing towards the core sensor interface starting with the optical front-end.

title: Fix: Dropdown Delete Label Styling & Sidebar Active Highlight Fix
description: 1. Renamed Delete Conversation to Delete in the coder sidebar dropdown menu, and styled both the text and trash icon red (#dc2626). 2. Removed the grey background highlight from active sidebar action buttons, setting it to transparent so they no longer look hovered on load.

title: Fix: Enforced Chronological Tool Execution and Final Response Ordering
description: 1. Configured frontend stream handlers in agent_stream.js and coder_stream_render.js to seal/finalize active response bubbles as soon as a tool starts executing. 2. Added prompt guidelines in config/system_prompt.py forcing the model to complete all tool operations first before formulating and outputting the final summary or table.

impact: The assistant now consistently reads files and runs tools first, generating the final summary report last. In rare cases where text and tools interleave, bubbles are split cleanly to preserve 100% chronological order.

title: Feature: Implemented Custom Modal Dialogs for Delete/Rename Actions

reason: User requested a custom UI popup modal instead of browser native alerts for delete confirmation in coding sessions.
impact: Renaming and deleting coding sessions or chat threads now trigger a beautiful, centered overlay modal with backdrop blur instead of generic browser prompt alerts.

title: Fix: Added CSS Styling for Codex-style Execution Feed
description: Added styling classes .action-label (Layer 1 ACTION) and .finding-label (Layer 3 FINDING) to both chat.css and coder.css.
reason: To support the styling of the new 3-layer execution feed.
impact: Consistent, polished visual labels across both chat and coder pages.

title: Fix: Implement Codex-style 3-Layer Execution Feed
description: Restructured event handlers in agent_stream.js and coder_stream_render.js. Emits e.data from 'reasoning' as an ACTION label, groups tool badges in Layer 2, and prints reasoning_chunks as a compact 2-sentence FINDING label in Layer 3. think_chunk is now fully suppressed.
reason: To follow Codex/Claude Code alternating pattern and eliminate monologue clutter in main chat.
impact: Chat flow is clean, action-oriented, and shows real findings rather than internal thoughts.

title: Fix: Suppress Thought Preview on Expand and Support file_path in Coder View
description: 1. Hides the collapsed thought preview row when the thought card body is expanded to eliminate duplicated text. 2. Added support for file_path and filePath parameter parsing in coder_stream_render.js so that refactoring edits display correct filenames instead of a fallback extension.
reason: User reported visual duplication in expanded thought blocks and incorrect txt file names for refactoring tool cards.
impact: The thought process UI is now cleaner with no duplicate paragraphs when expanded. File names for refactor steps are fully resolved.

title: Fix: Prevent Duplication in Coder View Thought Blocks

reason: User reported that the Coder thought block preview duplicated the outside brief action descriptions.
impact: Coder thought block previews now display only the actual internal thinking process, matching the IDE behavior.

title: Fix: Resolve Exact Filename in File Edit Summaries
description: Updated rawPath extraction in coder_stream_render.js and agent_stream.js to check for TargetFile and target_file arguments. This resolves a bug where tools modifying files (like replace_file_content) showed a generic txt label instead of the actual filename.
reason: User reported that file edit cards showed txt instead of the exact filename.
impact: File edit blocks now display their real filenames (e.g. index.html) instead of just txt.

title: Fix: Unified Headline and Bold Text Font Weights to 500

reason: User requested to further reduce the bold weight of both headings and strong text.
impact: Conversational messages now feature lighter, cleaner headings and bold text tags.

title: Fix: Adjust Chat Headings to Medium Bold and Smaller Sizes
description: 1. Adjusted .msg.ai headings (h1-h4) sizes down by 1-2px so they remain highly integrated with conversation flow. 2. Changed font weight of headings and strong/bold text to medium bold (550) to make it softer and less document-like.
reason: User requested that big headlines and big text be 1-2px smaller and medium bold.

impact: Users can now jump into the Coder IDE directly from the main chat sidebar actions list.

title: Fixed Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC) on Page Load
description: Refactored index.html structure by moving the settings modal inside the <body> tag (it was previously placed before <!DOCTYPE html> which caused raw HTML flashing before CSS loaded). Added an inline <style> block in the <head> to explicitly set .modal-overlay.hidden { display: none !important; } and set #shell { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in; }. Updated main.js boot() sequence to gracefully fade-in the shell element after 900ms when the JS initialization completes.
reason: User reported raw unstyled pages (modals/settings) appearing for 1 second during page load, causing a bad UX.
impact: Page loads are now buttery smooth. The screen remains a solid dark color without flashing broken UI elements until the JS has fully initialized and faded in the app shell.

title: Fixed chat page breadcrumb and sidebar bleed bugs
description: Bug 1: Breadcrumb showed coder project path on chat page. Fixed by: (a) guarding updateCoderBreadcrumb() to only fire when router.currentPage=coder, (b) guarding selectConversation and startNewConversationTemp similarly, (c) adding updateTitleBreadcrumb empty call in router case chat, (d) adding initRouterState() function called at boot after initCoderPage() to forcibly reset DOM. Bug 2: Coder sidebar items bleeding into chat page. Fixed by: initRouterState() calls _hideAllPanes() on boot since navigateTo guard skips same-page nav, triple-hiding nav-inner-coder in chat/skills router cases.
reason: User saw D:\\WEB breadcrumb on chat page and Refactor my codebase / Connecting... coder sidebar items bleeding into chat sidebar on initial page load.
impact: Chat welcome page now shows clean empty breadcrumb and no coder sidebar elements.

title: Fixed Coder Page Element Bleeding on Navigation
description: Three-layer fix: teardownCoderPage() JS cleanup on leave, router triple-hide of nav-inner-coder, CSS isolation with isolation:isolate and z-index scoping.
reason: Coder page elements (Connecting status, action buttons) were bleeding into other pages sidebar after navigation.
impact: Navigation from Coder page is now clean with zero element bleed.

reason: User requested long, Claude-level project-based rules specifically for coding-related tools.
impact: Coding agent will use workspace tools with maximum safety and structural precision.

title: Removed App Initiation Planning Phase
description: Updated layer2_rules.md to completely remove the 3-Phase App/Website Initiation Workflow (Polishing, Tech Stack, and Planning phases). Replaced it with Direct Coding Execution: the agent will now immediately execute file writes and testing without wasting turns on meta-planning and recommendations.
reason: User requested removal of the rule requiring the agent to plan and recommend tech stacks first before writing code.

Refactored styling in style.css to support overlays, badges, and smooth sliding transitions.
reason: User authorized proactive implementation for the Amazon frontend clone.

title: Tool call tag stripping from chat bubbles

title: Real AI Streaming for Hekki Coder Chat
description:
Built an isolated, clean 3-layer streaming architecture for the Hekki Coder page:
1. coder_stream_core.js (Part 1, <500 lines) — manages WS connection to /api/coder/ws with auto-reconnect, queuing, context sync, sendCoderChat() API.
2. coder_stream_render.js (Part 2, <500 lines) — manages streaming bubble creation, incremental markdown rendering, typing cursor, think labels, tool bars, done/error finalization.
3. connection.py — added _handle_chat_command() which calls agent.run() and streams chat_thinking, chat_chunk, chat_think_chunk, chat_tool_start, chat_tool_end, chat_done, chat_error events back to the client.
4. coder_page.js — replaced fake sendCoderMessage stub with real delegation to stream modules; all legacy FSM events still routed via window._handleCoderLegacyEvent shim.
reason: User prompts sent from Hekki Coder were not reaching the real AI agent; a hardcoded stub replied instead.
impact: Hekki Coder chat now delivers real, streamed AI responses with token-by-token display, think labels, code block copy buttons, and proper error feedback — completely isolated from the main chat page.

title: Coder Engine v2: Bug fixes, AST cache, preview_patch, 7 WebSocket commands
description: (1) Fixed ASTNodeInfo dataclass: children=field(default_factory=list) prevents shared mutable default. (2) Fixed end_lineno attribute (was end_line, always returned start_line). (3) Added mtime-keyed module-level AST parse cache (64 slots) to skip re-parsing unchanged files. (4) Added list_all_symbols() API. (5) Added preview_patch() unified diff dry-run in DiffPatcher. (6) Added coder_engine/__init__.py. (7) Expanded WebSocket to 7 commands: ping, get_status, read_file, list_dir, preview_patch, list_symbols, refactor. (8) 4 new unit tests (bug regressions + new API coverage). Total: 22/22 tests passing.
reason: Backend audit found 2 real bugs and 4 missing features needed for production use.
impact: AST symbol detection now correct with proper line ranges. Cache eliminates redundant parse overhead on large files. Frontend can now browse workspace, preview diffs, and inspect symbols entirely over WebSocket without REST calls.

title: Complete Coder Engine Backend Wiring
description: Fixed 4 identified gaps: (1) diff_patcher.py verify_syntax now checks Python/JSON/JS/TS/JSX/TSX with language-specific parsers. (2) coder_refactor/skill.py integrates CoderFSM state tracking (ANALYZING->VALIDATING->APPLYING->IDLE) with token budget reporting in SkillResult metadata. (3) connection.py fully wired with _handle_refactor_command that drives the complete FSM+ASTGuard+DiffPatcher pipeline and broadcasts live state events over WebSocket. (4) 5 new unit tests added covering JSON syntax check, unknown file type pass-through.
reason: Backend audit revealed connection.py only handled ping/get_status; FSM and syntax checkers were stubs. Full end-to-end wiring was required.

title: Integrate Coder Engine & Coder Refactor Skill

title: Implement Decoupled Coder Engine Backend

impact: Provides a secure local sandbox, prevents infinite loops, reduces token overhead, and maintains system stability.

reason: Requested by user to clean up unnecessary files and duplicate the cleaned codebase to the D drive.
impact: Reduces codebase noise and size, and archives the project to the D drive.

title: WebSocket Real Agent Execution Bridge
description: Replaced the frontend timer-based mock simulation in the agent workspace with a live, two-way WebSocket execution bridge. When a user submits a coding prompt in the agent page, the query is dispatched directly to the backend MarianoAgent ReAct loop. Real-time events (reasoning steps, tool calls, tool results, diff generation, and terminal logs) are streamed back and updated live in the Checklist, Diffs, and Terminal telemetry tabs.
reason: To convert the mock-only agent workspace UI into a fully functional, production-grade autonomous agent client that writes actual files and runs terminal commands.
impact: Enables actual project code creation, editing, and execution runs triggered directly from the Agentic Workspace web interface.

title: Monolithic Frontend Code splitting & Refactoring
description: Refactored the agent_page.js monolithic workspace view (900+ lines of code) by splitting it into 5 dedicated, lightweight JavaScript modules in static/js/pages/agent/. The modules are: (1) layout_manager.js (panel bounds/collapse resizing), (2) welcome_manager.js (welcome route and textarea triggers), (3) chat_renderer.js (left chat logs), (4) panel_renderer.js (checklist/diff/terminal tabs integration), and (5) simulation_runner.js (background scans and test suites runs).
reason: To eliminate monolithic front-end source files and establish a clean, modular structure complying with strict single-responsibility patterns.
impact: Improves code readability, testability, and layout stability across agent sessions.

title: PowerShell & CMD Shell Executor Integration
description: Refactored the system_control skill into a modular directory structure and added a highly robust PowerShell/CMD runner action ('run_shell'). It implements custom multi-encoding fallback checks (UTF-8 -> CP1252 -> CP437 -> UTF-16 -> replace) preventing any Unicode decode crashes on Windows. A comprehensive shell execution guide has also been compiled to instruct the agent on command groups, interactive prompt bypasses, and state-loss limitations.
reason: To enable the agent to run 100+ diagnostic, system, and compilation shell commands natively on Windows without encoding crashes.
impact: Provides the agent with full powershell access scoped dynamically inside the path guard sandbox in project mode.

title: Advanced Parallel Search & HTML-to-Markdown Scraper Upgrade
description: Upgraded the agent's core tools to expert-level capabilities. (1) FileManagerSkill now features a parallel thread pool grep action supporting regular expression matching across the workspace directory recursively. (2) WebScraperSkill has been upgraded to convert structural HTML (headings, paragraphs, lists, links, tables) into clean Markdown, providing high-fidelity readable context to the agent during online research.
reason: To elevate basic foundation tools to faster, structured, and expert-level capabilities matching real-world coding agents.
impact: Enables the agent to instantly locate variables/functions across complex projects using grep, and crawl structured documentations without losing markdown formatting.

title: Autonomous Execution & Permission Boundary Control
description: Upgraded the agent's plan checklist to execute autonomously ('Turbo Power') without requiring manual authorization clicks. Locked core system access (Base Mode) behind explicit chat-based keyword verification ('all system permission' / 'full system permission'). If not explicitly granted, all execution and file modifications are sandboxed inside the active project folder boundary.
reason: To make the workspace execution autonomous while enforcing a robust, explicit permission boundary protecting the core system files.
impact: Improves user experience by automating repetitive checklist approvals while ensuring absolute file system safety.

title: Project Sidebar Actions Menu
description: Added a 3-dot dropdown popover actions menu to project directories listed in the left sidebar panel of the agent page. Users can now remove an entire project folder and delete its sessions, or start a new coding session inside that project directly from the tree view.
reason: User wanted project-level folder removal operations and workspace folder action options in the sidebar.
impact: Provides a premium, native IDE experience for workspace organization and project session management.

title: Dual-Mode Workspace Sandbox Isolation
description: Implemented PathGuard in core/workspace.py to restrict file system queries (file_manager) and code execution subprocesses (code_executor) to isolated project directories located dynamically under data/workspaces/<project_id>/. Core agent system is automatically split between Base System Mode (Self-Evolution) and Isolated Workspace Mode based on intent classification.
reason: To protect the agent's core codebase from runaway loops or unintended modifications during project coding by sandboxing execution inside specific directories.
impact: Ensures absolute filesystem security and portable directory path resolution, allowing users to build coding projects safely without breaking the base system.

title: Fixed Tool Call Parsing in Streamed Responses
description: Fixed a bug in gemini/client.py where using generate_content_stream caused tool calls to be discarded (returning an empty tool_calls array). Re-implemented stream parser to examine chunk candidates and gather function_call parts, and caught ValueError exceptions when text properties are queried on non-text chunks.
reason: Whenever the user asked the agent to execute a file change, the model returned a function_call instead of text, which was discarded in streaming mode, causing an 'Empty response from AI' stop error.
impact: Restores complete ReAct tool execution capability during streamed chat sessions, enabling smooth file changes and command execution.

title: Fixed Model Dropdown Menu Positioning & Widget Replay

Overwrote cached ui_events to prevent old historical widget panels from auto-spawning on server boot.
reason: User reported that the model select list was overlapping, cut off, and transparent, and empty widget tabs were automatically opening on restart.
impact: Restores normal layout positioning, resolves dropdown transparency, and prevents annoying widget restarts on boot.

title: Stop Generation Control Buttons

description: Developed a collapsible Card renderer inside the chat client that formats streaming agent_events and parses static <think> tags. The reasoning card sits preceding the final response block.
reason: User wanted to see both inner reasoning/thoughts process first and then the final response or conclusion.
impact: Provides a highly clean, collapsible UI for tracing the AI's internal thoughts and tool-calling reasoning before consuming final responses.

title: Automated Ollama Service Startup in Launcher
description: Modified run_app.bat script to automatically detect whether the local Ollama background service is active, and trigger 'ollama serve' in background if it's missing.
reason: User wanted to make sure that running the app starts everything (Ollama, Python backend, and Electron dashboard) in one click.
impact: Ensures offline model execution runs out of the box with single-click launcher integration.

title: Polished Settings Avatar and Claude Typography
description: Aligned the avatar display in settings as a perfect centered circle, updated select dropdowns and textareas to a clean 6px border-radius, and strictly enforced Inter font families for the interface.
reason: User reported that the avatar in settings was too big/unstructured, and requested to use Claude-style typography (strictly Inter and Lora serif details) and clean up control alignments.
impact: Improves settings panel visuals, resolves the broken avatar bounding box, and creates a highly cohesive Claude-like UI design.

title: Integrated Dynamic Model Selector & Auto Memory Selection
description: Wired up dynamic model pill indicators to display 'QWEN (Offline)' or 'Gemini' based on settings, and implemented automatic episodic memory retrieval (RAG) at startup of new conversations.
reason: Ensure the active model selection is correctly represented in input pills, and automatically inject relevant long-term memories for dialogue context continuity.
impact: Provides immediate visibility of the active model, and automates context continuity through auto memory retrieval.

title: Redesigned Capabilities Engine UI Layout
description: Converted the bulky, tall card-grid UI of the Expert Skills page into a compact, flat, table-row list view with boxy outlines, consistent with the workspace layout.
reason: User wanted a cleaner, more structured, less bloated view that matches the folder page style instead of large unorganized cards.
impact: Improves layout alignment, reduces scroll length, and makes monitoring capabilities far more structured.

title: Enforced AI Auto-Logging Customizations
description: Created workspace-scoped AGENTS.md rules file to force the AI assistant to write log entries automatically whenever codebase upgrades occur.
reason: Ensure the System Evolution Ledger stays in sync with changes without manual developer tracking.
impact: Enforces automation and log integrity in system evolution audit history.

title: Integrated AI Evolution Ledger (System Changelog)
description: Added a dedicated, separate audit history explorer inside the far-left sidebar dock. Users can now view AI-written changelogs, reasons, and impacts.
reason: User wanted a transparent, clean ledger interface (resembling a clean folder list style) to track app upgrades, core refactors, and skill additions written automatically by the AI itself.
impact: Enhances trust and system observability by providing a clean audit log of all autonomous improvements.

title: Local Ollama (Offline Model) Support
description: Implemented backend support for local offline models (targeting 'qwen' by default) and updated settings UI with Gemini and Ollama key/URL config inputs.
reason: Enable local offline model usage when internet access is unavailable or for local performance execution.
impact: Provides offline robustness and hybrid (Gemini + Ollama) model execution fallback.

title: Dedicated Capabilities & Tool Registry Page
description: Created a clean, modern grid card page for monitoring and configuring registered expert skills, complete with search and toggle tools.
reason: User requested a separated capabilities manager panel that doesn't mix with chat views, allowing enable/disable triggers.
impact: Improves tool transparency and user control, letting users disable capabilities they don't want the agent to use.

title: Created Zero-VoIP Real Estate AI Calling & Shizuku Audio Bridge Starter Codebase
description: Implemented complete starter codebase for Zero-VoIP Telephony Bridge: 1. Android Native App (Kotlin: ShizukuAudioBridge for elevated PCM audio capture, GeminiLiveWebSocketClient for direct 16kHz PCM streaming to Gemini Live API, and CallBridgeForegroundService). 2. FastAPI Backend Server (WebSockets + REST API + SQLite DB for Real Estate lead extraction and status relay). 3. Real-Time Dashboard HUD (HTML5 UI for outbound call triggering and live lead card updates).
reason: User requested complete working starter code skeleton for the Shizuku zero-VoIP real estate calling system.
impact: Enables immediate end-to-end testing of zero-cost cellular SIM calls connected to Google Gemini Multimodal Live API without per-minute VoIP provider costs.

title: Configured Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio Live Call Bridge over Bluetooth
description: Integrated OPPO A5 Pro 5G and iPhone 13 Pro Bluetooth Hands-Free Profile (bthhfenum.sys) directly with Google Gemini Multimodal Live API (models/gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-latest). Fixed Windows mic echo loopback by unchecking Listen to this device, and locked output streams directly into the phone call earpiece.
reason: User requested testing real-time phone call automation using their paired smartphone over Bluetooth.
impact: Enables zero-cost per-minute AI phone call automation with zero-latency audio streaming directly through paired smartphones.

title: AWS Cloud Telephony Gateway Deployment
description: Deployed cloud_telephony_gateway.js to AWS Lightsail (3.109.44.87, Mumbai ap-south-1). PM2 process running. React app auto-switches between localhost:8000 (dev) and 3.109.44.87:8000 (prod) via config/gateway.js. Twilio TwiML personalized with customerName/property from campaign data.

title: Pluggable Telephony Driver Architecture
description: Refactored cloud telephony engine to Modular Adapter/Plugin Pattern. Created zero_voip_telephony_bridge/providers (BaseProvider, TwilioProvider, PlivoProvider, ExotelProvider, ProviderManager). Adding new telephony services (Twilio, Exotel, Plivo, Airtel) requires zero changes to core gateway code.

title: Fix Double Call Bug — Removed StrictMode + Call Dedup Guard

Added callLockRef + 8s cooldown guard in App.jsx DashboardLayout to prevent duplicate initiate-ai-call event handling from multiple dispatchers (AllLeadsPage, RowActionMenu, PhoneDialerModal, DailyScheduleOverviewPage).

title: Voice Preview Cards + HTTPS Gateway (hekki.gharvanta.in)

WSS WebSocket proxy configured for Gemini Live Audio streaming. 3) Updated gateway.js to use https://hekki.gharvanta.in for production.

title: Live Billing Dashboard — Real Twilio Credit & Call Data
description: Added /api/billing/live endpoint in cloud_telephony_gateway.js that fetches real Twilio account balance and last 25 call records in parallel. Rewrote BillingPage.jsx to consume live data with auto-refresh every 60 seconds, real USD/INR balance display, live call records table with status badges, CSV export, and recharge modal.

description: Updated typography rules across 2_base.css, 3_layout.css, 4_components.css, KpiCards.css, and PhoneDialerModal.css to change font-weight from 600 to 400 for small text, form input labels, micro-kpi titles, numpad subtext, and navigation group headings for a lighter modern look.

Connected renderer theme changes via IPC (set-theme) so titleBarOverlay background dynamically switches between #121315 (Dark Mode) and #FFFFFF (Light Mode) with crisp symbol icons.

description: Updated Sidebar.jsx and 3_layout.css to display short square logo icon assets when the sidebar is collapsed: /short-logo-for-white.png for Light theme and /Short-logo-dark.png for Dark theme.

description: Updated all dropdown popovers and action menus (Table Row Action Menu, Top Search Autocomplete, Notifications Popover Drawer) with Dark Theme surface backgrounds (#1A1B1D), subtle dark borders (#2B2C30), crisp off-white item text (#F1F1F1), and soft hover highlights.

Adjusted vertical positioning so bottom table row action menus pop upward cleanly without overlapping table footers.

description: Replaced variable text color overrides in ActiveCallWidget with explicit vibrant colors (#38BDF8 Sky Blue for status/audio/icons, #10B981 Emerald for active timer, #EF4444 Red for end call button) ensuring 100% text readability over dark obsidian floating widget background.

description: Added /api/telephony/hangup endpoint on Cloud Telephony Gateway to invoke Twilio API (calls.update status=completed) and connected it directly to the dashboard ActiveCallWidget End Call button. Dispatched Call SIDs are captured and terminated live.

title: Real-Time Twilio Receiver Answer / Pickup Event Synchronization
description: Replaced fixed 2.5s timer auto-start with real-time statusCallback listener (/api/twilio/status). The live timer (00:00) now ONLY starts counting after the receiver actually answers the call (in-progress event). If the receiver declines, misses, or hangs up, the timer stops and status switches to Call Disconnected.

title: Removed Hardcoded Fallback Timer & Connected Real-Time WebSocket Twilio Event Stream
description: Removed 6-second automatic fallback timer from ActiveCallWidget.jsx so the system remains strictly in Dialing SIM state until an actual in-progress event is received from Twilio via WebSocket in App.jsx.

title: Fixed ReferenceError GATEWAY_URL in ActiveCallWidget.jsx
description: Added missing import { GATEWAY_URL } from ../../config/gateway at top of ActiveCallWidget.jsx resolving the console error on call hangup.

title: Restarted Cloud Telephony Gateway to load /api/telephony/hangup route
description: Killed background node gateway process and restarted node cloud_telephony_gateway.js to register the newly added /api/telephony/hangup POST endpoint on port 8000.

title: Twilio Application Error TwiML & Webhook Route Fix
description: Fixed Twilio application error (An error has occurred) by updating TwiML XML formatting in TwilioProvider.js to use public SSL domain (hekki.gharvanta.in) for action webhooks and media WebSockets, avoiding 404/500 errors on internal localhost URLs.

title: Direct WebSocket Gemini AI Stream TwiML Integration
description: Simplified TwilioProvider.js TwiML to directly initiate Connect Stream url wss://hekki.gharvanta.in/cloud-stream. Removed intermediate Gather action loop which was causing Twilio Application Error on keypress.

title: Instant UI Widget Disconnect Sync on Phone Hangup
description: Added instant twilio-call-status completed broadcast on WebRTC Media Stream socket close (ws.on close) in cloud_telephony_gateway.js. When the user cuts the call on their physical phone, the media stream socket immediately closes, triggering the React UI widget to switch to Call Disconnected and close.

title: Twilio Error 13520 and 21609 Root Cause Fix on Production Server
description: Fixed TwilioProvider.js on AWS production server (hekki.gharvanta.in). Root causes: (1) Error 13520 - SSML prosody/break tags were invalid in Polly.Kajal voice causing Say Invalid text. Fixed by using plain concatenation. (2) Error 21609 - statusCallbackUrl pointed to localhost:8000 which Twilio cannot reach. Fixed by hardcoding https://hekki.gharvanta.in/api/twilio/status. Deployed via scp and restarted pm2 hekki-gateway. No more application error on phone call.

title: Widget Status Sync + AI Voice Fixes
description: 1) Added GET /api/telephony/poll/:callSid endpoint to local gateway that queries Twilio REST API every 3s and broadcasts to local WebSocket clients. 2) ActiveCallWidget.jsx now uses hybrid polling + WebSocket for reliable status updates. 3) Restored Connect Stream wss://hekki.gharvanta.in/cloud-stream in TwilioProvider.js TwiML for Gemini AI voice. Uses plain Say (no Polly voice attribute) to avoid Error 13520.

title: Twilio mulaw 8kHz to Gemini PCM 16kHz Audio Conversion Fix
description: Root cause of voice not working: Twilio sends audio as mulaw 8000Hz but Gemini needs PCM 16000Hz. Added bidirectional conversion: mulawToPcm16k() for Twilio->Gemini direction and pcm16kToMulaw() for Gemini->Twilio direction. Deployed to both local gateway and AWS production server.

title: Gemini Live Voice Greeting - No Twilio TTS
description: Removed Twilio TTS Say tag from TwiML completely. Now TwiML only has Connect Stream. Gateway sends proactive clientContent greeting to Gemini on setupComplete so Gemini speaks first in its own Puck voice. Both local and server gateways updated.

title: Global AI Response Typography & Font Weight Synchronization Across All Pages
description: Standardized AI response typography and font weights across all views (Main Chat, Code Studio / Coder, Debate Playground, and HUD Voice Overlay). Set explicit font-weight: 300 (light weight) for base AI body text/paragraphs, unbolded font-weight: 400 for inline strong/bold elements, font-weight: 555 (medium bold) for headings, and font-weight: 500 for code chips across chat.css, coder.css, debate.css, and overlay.html.

title: Enforced Borderless Flat Background Fills on Inline Code Chips
description: Completely removed outlines and borders (border: none !important; outline: none !important;) from all inline code chips, directory path badges, and code elements across light, dark, and OLED themes. Applied soft flat background fills (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) in dark mode, #e5e7eb / var(--hover) in light mode) in chat.css, coder.css, debate.css, and overlay.html.

title: Restored Bold Weight Emphasis (font-weight: 600) on Markdown Strong and B Tags

This ensures key terms, bullet labels, and double-asterisk Markdown text (**term**) stand out with crisp visual contrast against 300-weight body copy.

title: Left Sidebar Icons Theme Synchronization & 2.2px Stroke Weight Enhancement
description: Updated left sidebar and global Lucide SVG icons in layout.css to be 100% theme-dependent (using var(--text-2) / var(--text-primary) and stroke: currentColor) across Light, Dark, and OLED themes. Enforced 100% opacity visibility (opacity: 1 !important) and increased icon stroke-width from 1.75px to a crisp, mid-bold 2.2px (2.4px on hover/active) for ultra-sharp visibility.

title: Hekki Writing Style Guide v1 System Prompt Specification Integration
description: Embedded the complete Hekki Writing Style Guide v1 into system_prompt.py. Enforced 60% text / 40% whitespace density, 2-3 line short paragraphs, natural human headings ('Overall', 'Bottom line', 'What should you do next?'), max 5 bullets per list with format rhythm mixing, selective 1-2 word bolding, 1 emoji per section, callout blocks (> 💡, > 🟢, > ⚠️), and concrete examples for effortless reading flow.

title: Minor Font Weight Increase on AI Response Paragraph Sublines (300 to 400)

title: Reduced Bottom Disclaimer Text Size to Very Small 10px

Enforced width: 100% !important, max-width: 720px !important, and box-sizing: border-box !important across .bottom-col, .debate-input-area, .debate-input-wrapper, .debate-active-progress-card, and .debate-active-search-card. Added min-width: 0 !important to main chat and debate flex panes in layout.css to prevent content expansion horizontal overflow.

title: Synchronized User Message Bubble Font Weight (400) with AI Response Copy
description: Updated .msg.user, .coder-msg-user, and .user-bubble across chat.css, coder.css, and debate.css to font-weight: 400 and font-size: 14.5px. User messages now match the exact font weight, crispness, and reading metrics of AI response sublines.

description: Fine-tuned font-size of leftbar navigation links, action buttons (.sidebar-action-btn, .btn-new-chat-dock), recent session item labels (.section-item .lbl), Coder sidebar conversation titles (.coder-conv-item, .coder-conv-title-text), and Debate room sidebar topic titles (.debate-doc-item-title, .dir-topic-title) to exactly 14px.

Removed outer borders and shadows (`border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important;`), updated table headers to 13.5px font-weight: 600, increased cell padding to 10px 14px with crisp line-height: 1.6, removed vertical grid lines, added subtle row hover states, and seamless top header bar with copy CSV functionality.

Changed code block language titles from forced UPPERCASE (e.g., PYTHON) to clean lowercase (e.g., python, javascript) matching official ChatGPT code cards.

Restricted inline code pill selectors to :not(pre) > code, and enforced white-space: pre !important on pre and pre code containers so multiline code preserves exact newline formatting.

Emits standardized OpenAI-compatible SSE events with delta token chunks, tool call triggers, and stop signals for seamless external client integration.

description: Updated font-weight of user menu dropdown items (.user-menu-item, .user-menu-header) and attachment menu dropdown items (.attach-dropdown-item) across layout.css and chat.css to font-weight: 400 !important. Eliminates heavy bold fonts in dropdowns for a clean, sleek corporate look matching reference UI.
